items.title: datasette 1.0a43
items.snippet: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. items.title: datasette 0.65.6
items.snippet: Release: datasette 0.65.6 I backported a minor security fix from 1.0a43: Fixed a security issue where a database registered using add_database(db, name=..., route=...) with a route that differs from its name could be downloaded from /<route>.db by actors who were denied access to it.
